title: Abstract Bird Coil Spring Rider
description: One original low-poly abstract bird-shaped rider in one fixed static pose: a thick coral profile body, separate thick petrol saddle, transverse metal handle with two grips, transverse foot bar with two foot pads, and a single continuous three-turn vertical helical spring. The spring has a real closed ten-sided circular section and visible positive turn spacing, with both ends embedded in distinct fixing plates. The upper plate joins the body and the lower plate joins a broad finite grounded base. Constant opaque PBR colors only. One complete assembly counts as one prop. Metres, Z up, bird faces +X, origin at ground under the coil axis. Original simplified silhouette with no characters, logos, textures, extra rider, soft mat or scene. Static visual geometry only: no spring deformation, rocking, motion, physical simulation, child/adult fit, age guidance, load rating, installation fit, stability or anti-tip performance, manufacturing specification or playground/child safety certification. No asserted compatibility with existing scenes or mats.
